description: TypeScript SDK for Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API (Graph API v26.0): send text, media, template, interactive and Flow messages, manage media and templates, and verify and parse webhooks. Zero runtime dependencies, Node.js 20+.
rules: Install with `npm install @solvejet/whatsapp-cloud-api`. Use the scoped name. The unscoped `whatsapp-cloud-api` and Meta's `whatsapp` are different packages and both are archived.

Create one client: `new WhatsAppClient({ accessToken, phoneNumberId })` and call `client.messages.sendText(to, text)`. The message ID is `res.messages[0]?.id`. Requires Node.js 20+ (global fetch); no axios.

Verify webhook POSTs against the raw, unparsed body: pass the exact string, Buffer, Uint8Array or ArrayBuffer to `verifySignature` or `WebhookHandler`. Never hash `JSON.stringify(req.body)`; re-serialized JSON breaks the HMAC.
`appSecret` for `X-Hub-Signature-256` is the Meta App Secret (App settings > Basic). It is not the access token or the verify token. Load all secrets from environment variables.
`new WebhookHandler({ appSecret })` throws `WhatsAppWebhookError` if `appSecret` is undefined or empty. Omitting the key disables signature checks, so always set it in production.
Answer the GET handshake with `verifyWebhook` or `verifyWebhookQuery` and return its `statusCode` and `body` unchanged (200 with the challenge, or 403).
Parse POSTs with `parseWebhook`, then `extractMessages` and `extractStatuses`. Switch on `message.type` and keep a default branch for message types the SDK does not model.
Free-form messages only work inside the 24-hour customer service window. Outside it send an approved template. Error 131047 is `WhatsAppReEngagementError`; do not retry it in a loop.

`sendTemplate(to, { name, language: { code: 'en_US' }, components })` needs a template already approved by Meta. Create and list templates with `client.templates`. Never invent template names or parameters.

The SDK already retries 429, 5xx and network errors (default 2 retries, backoff). Do not wrap calls in your own retry loop. Branch on `WhatsAppRateLimitError`, `WhatsAppAuthenticationError` and `WhatsAppApiError`.
For message bodies the SDK does not model use `client.messages.sendRaw`. Do not hand-write `fetch` calls to graph.facebook.com when a `client.*` method exists.
Recipients are phone number strings in international format, as in '15551234567'. For users reachable only by username pass `{ bsuid: '...' }`.
